description: This file defines the FormField class, which models individual fields within a form in the OpenMRS healthcare system. It includes properties for field hierarchy, form association, ordering, and constraints, along with comparison logic for sorting form fields.

classes.name: FormField
classes.description: Represents a field within a form, with attributes to handle hierarchy, ordering, and field constraints. Implements comparison for sorting based on weights, page, and field number.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Comparison logic used for ordering FormField instances based on sort weight, page number, field number, and other attributes.
